headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Memorable moments from Trump rallies ahead of the midterms
headlines.description: President Trump has made several comments about people's appearances during recent rallies ahead of the midterms. In Michigan, he commented on the singer Nicki Minaj's physique, and in South Carolina he called a heckler who was punched during the event "unattractive."

headlines.title: Milwaukee Brewers win first World Series title
headlines.description: The Milwaukee Brewers secured their first World Series title with a 4-1 win over the Tampa Bay Rays in Game 5 at Tropicana Field in St. Petersburg, Florida.

headlines.title: Labor rights icon Dolores Huerta dies at 96
headlines.description: Dolores Huerta, who co-founded the United Farm Workers union with Cesar Chavez, spent decades fighting for marginalized communities and inspired generations with her rallying cry “Sí se puede.” NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. takes shortcut to make some unapproved peptides available for use
headlines.description: HHS is pausing legal action against compounding pharmacies that make certain peptides, effectively allowing them to offer the unapproved drugs immediately.

headlines.title: Brazil’s Flávio Bolsonaro arrives in U.S. after losing election
headlines.description: Brazilian Sen. Flávio Bolsonaro and his family have arrived in Miami, where the U.S. government will grant them entry visas after he refused to comply with Brazil’s order to surrender his passports. NBC News’ Carlos Curbelo explains how Bolsonaro was granted entry and its impact on U.S.-Brazil relations.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Milwaukee Brewers defeat Tampa Bay Rays to claim first World Series title
headlines.description: The Milwaukee Brewers’ 57-season wait for a World Series title ended Wednesday as they defeated the Tampa Bay Rays in five games.

headlines.title: Manhunt grows for escaped murderer who may have left area where truck was ditched
headlines.description: Jacob Morley, who fatally shot a co-worker, escaped Sunday from a prison in Tennessee. The work truck he allegedly stole was found in Illinois.

headlines.title: California judge denies Trump DOJ request to segregate alleged noncitizen ballots
headlines.description: A federal judge in California on Wednesday refused the Trump administration’s request to segregate 20,000 mail-in ballots from individuals it alleges are noncitizens.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere’s death is ruled accidental and police investigation is closed
headlines.description: Panettiere, 36, died of the toxic effects of multiple drugs, including fentanyl, the coroner determined.

headlines.title: Meet the Democrats trying to flip the script on gun rights: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.
